title: SkillScannerAnnotation
description: One annotation record produced by a native-speaker annotator (Pass B) or an auditor (Pass A) under PROTOCOL.md.

skill_id.description: Stable identifier of the Skill being annotated. Matches the dataset's Skill identifier (e.g., HeadyZhang/skills-crosslingual-security row id) or the relative SKILL.md path.

language.description: Primary language of the Skill as declared in the dataset row. The annotator MUST be a native speaker of this language (Pass B).

rule_id.description: Rule the finding was emitted under. For Pass A this is an AGENT-* code-level rule; for Pass B this is SKILL-010.

annotator_id.description: Stable, pseudonymous identifier for the annotator (e.g., 'ja-A', 'ja-B', 'ja-adjudicator'). Same identifier MUST refer to the same human across records.

verdict.description: Final label for this finding. TP = the scanner's flag was correct; FP = the scanner's flag was incorrect.

rubric_pass.description: Pass B only. TRUE iff the description contains >=1 sentence communicating the Skill's functionality, written in the Skill's primary language. PROTOCOL §3.2: rubric_pass=true => verdict='FP'; rubric_pass=false => verdict='TP'. The two fields are intentionally redundant to catch annotator slips.

is_adjudication.description: TRUE iff this record is the third-annotator adjudication that resolves a disagreement (PROTOCOL §3.4). The adjudication record's verdict is the ground truth for that skill_id+rule_id pair.

notes.description: Optional free-text annotator notes. Kept verbatim; not used in scoring.

allOf.description: Consistency: rubric_pass=true must imply verdict=FP; rubric_pass=false must imply verdict=TP (PROTOCOL §3.2 binary rubric).
